verdict.rationale: Smithery was a hosted MCP connection gateway that proxied tool calls, so an audit log of those calls is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack never documents a tool-call log, audit trail, or replay capability. Token scoping, credential storage and CLI tool-call commands are adjacent features, not logging. The hosted connection services also shut down on 2026-10-31, leaving only a non-proxied registry.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see a log of every tool call that passed through the platform, with enough detail to audit or replay what an agent did
